description: Small illustrative subset of published no-ante HU pusher thresholds. Threshold >10 implies shove at 10BB; threshold <10 implies fold. No boundary or disjoint-range cases included.
limitations: Different number of players and ante
Nine-player SB range is conditioned on seven folds, with card removal from those policies
Only four illustrative hands, not a complete reference range
Reference is threshold guidance, not measured mixed frequencies
